name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: Menu root, trigger and popup with plain, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators and groups.
docs: Control open state with v-model:open when needed. Arrow keys move between items, Enter selects, Esc closes and focus returns to the trigger. DropdownMenuContent takes align, side and sideOffset; its minWidth defaults to 160px and its z-index is 50 so menus inside dialogs sit above the dialog. Radio items must sit inside DropdownMenuRadioGroup. Use the trigger's asChild prop to wrap the Button item instead of a raw button.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Menu as SdkMenu } from '@ui-sdk/vue/menu'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type DropdownMenuProps = {
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  /** Keeps the page scrollable while the menu is open. */
  modal?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<DropdownMenuProps>(), {
  defaultOpen: undefined,
  modal: false,
})

const open = defineModel<boolean>('open')
</script>

<template>
  <SdkMenu v-model:open="open" :default-open="defaultOpen" :modal="modal" v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </SdkMenu>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { MenuTrigger as SdkMenuTrigger } from '@ui-sdk/vue/menu'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type DropdownMenuTriggerProps = {
  /** Renders the trigger as another element or component (for example the Button item). */
  as?: string | object
  asChild?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<DropdownMenuTriggerProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
  disabled: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkMenuTrigger
    v-bind="$attrs"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :class="!asChild && 'h-auto border-0 bg-transparent p-0'"
  >
    <template #render="{ props: part }">
      <RenderChild v-if="asChild" v-bind="part"><slot /></RenderChild>
      <component :is="as" v-else v-bind="part"><slot /></component>
    </template>
  </SdkMenuTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { StyleValue } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { MenuContent as SdkMenuContent } from '@ui-sdk/vue/menu'
import { popupSurface } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type DropdownMenuContentProps = {
  align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end'
  /** Gap between the trigger and the popup, in pixels. */
  sideOffset?: number
  side?: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'
  /** Overrides the 160px minimum width from the reference menu. */
  minWidth?: number | string
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<DropdownMenuContentProps>(), {
  align: 'start',
  sideOffset: 8,
  side: 'bottom',
  minWidth: 160,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  delete rest.style
  return rest
})

function minWidthStyle(value: number | string): string {
  return typeof value === 'number' ? `${value}px` : value
}
</script>

<template>
  <SdkMenuContent
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :side="props.side"
    :side-offset="props.sideOffset"
    :align="props.align"
    :class="cn(popupSurface, attrs.class as ClassValue)"
    :style="[{ minWidth: minWidthStyle(props.minWidth) }, attrs.style as StyleValue]"
  >
    <slot />
  </SdkMenuContent>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { MenuItem as SdkMenuItem } from '@ui-sdk/vue/menu'
import { emitMenuSelect } from './selection'
import { menuItem } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type DropdownMenuItemProps = {
  disabled?: boolean
  /** Text used for typeahead when the item renders non-text content. */
  textValue?: string
}

withDefaults(defineProps<DropdownMenuItemProps>(), {
  disabled: false,
  textValue: undefined,
})

const emit = defineEmits<{ select: [event: Event] }>()

function onSelect(event: Event) {
  emitMenuSelect(event, (select) => emit('select', select))
}

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkMenuItem
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :label="textValue"
    :class="cn(menuItem, attrs.class as ClassValue)"
    @select="onSelect"
  >
    <slot />
  </SdkMenuItem>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { MenuGroup as SdkMenuGroup } from '@ui-sdk/vue/menu'
import { provide } from 'vue'
import { menuGroup, menuRadioValue } from './selection'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const model = defineModel<string>()
provide(menuRadioValue, model)
provide(menuGroup, true)
</script>

<template>
  <SdkMenuGroup v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </SdkMenuGroup>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { MenuGroupLabel as SdkMenuGroupLabel } from '@ui-sdk/vue/menu'
import { menuGroup } from './selection'
import { menuLabel } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const grouped = inject(menuGroup, false)
const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="grouped ? SdkMenuGroupLabel : 'div'"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(menuLabel, attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { MenuSeparator as SdkMenuSeparator } from '@ui-sdk/vue/menu'
import { menuSeparator } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkMenuSeparator v-bind="forwarded" :class="cn(menuSeparator, attrs.class as ClassValue)" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { MenuGroup as SdkMenuGroup } from '@ui-sdk/vue/menu'
import { provide } from 'vue'
import { menuGroup } from './selection'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

provide(menuGroup, true)
</script>

<template>
  <SdkMenuGroup v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </SdkMenuGroup>
</template>

/**
 * Shared surface for every floating layer, taken from the reference menu styles:
 * 16px radius, 1px line border, popup shadow and a 6px inset so items keep their
 * own 10px radius from touching the edge.
 */
export const popupSurface = [
  'z-50 overflow-hidden rounded-panel border border-line bg-raised p-1.5 shadow-popup outline-none',
  'origin-[var(--transform-origin)]',
  'data-[side=bottom]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:-4px]',
  'data-[side=top]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:4px]',
  'data-[side=left]:[--p0seid0n-pop-x:4px] data-[side=left]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:0px]',
  'data-[side=right]:[--p0seid0n-pop-x:-4px] data-[side=right]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:0px]',
  'motion-safe:animate-pop-in data-ending-style:motion-safe:animate-pop-out',
].join(' ')

export const menuItem = [
  'relative flex h-9 cursor-pointer select-none items-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] px-3',
  'text-[14px] font-medium text-ink-muted outline-none',
  'transition-[background-color,color] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-fast)] ease-out-expo motion-reduce:transition-none',
  'hover:bg-control hover:text-ink',
  'focus:bg-control focus:text-ink',
  'data-[highlighted]:bg-control data-[highlighted]:text-ink',
  'data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-55',
].join(' ')

export const menuLabel = 'px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-medium text-ink-faint'

export const menuSeparator = 'my-1 h-px bg-line'

export { default as DropdownMenu } from './DropdownMenu.vue'
export { default as DropdownMenuTrigger } from './DropdownMenuTrigger.vue'
export { default as DropdownMenuContent } from './DropdownMenuContent.vue'
export { default as DropdownMenuItem } from './DropdownMenuItem.vue'
export { default as DropdownMenuCheckboxItem } from './DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.vue'
export { default as DropdownMenuRadioGroup } from './DropdownMenuRadioGroup.vue'
export { default as DropdownMenuRadioItem } from './DropdownMenuRadioItem.vue'
export { default as DropdownMenuLabel } from './DropdownMenuLabel.vue'
export { default as DropdownMenuSeparator } from './DropdownMenuSeparator.vue'
export { default as DropdownMenuGroup } from './DropdownMenuGroup.vue'

export type { DropdownMenuProps } from './DropdownMenu.vue'
export type { DropdownMenuTriggerProps } from './DropdownMenuTrigger.vue'
export type { DropdownMenuContentProps } from './DropdownMenuContent.vue'
export type { DropdownMenuItemProps } from './DropdownMenuItem.vue'
export type { DropdownMenuCheckboxItemProps } from './DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.vue'
export type { DropdownMenuRadioItemProps } from './DropdownMenuRadioItem.vue'
